questions.question: Which among the following Mughal Emperor was illiterate?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Akbar__ **is known to be the most successful and the best Mughal Emperor who was illiterate.
 
• Some historians say that he had a physical disorder called dyslexia, in which a person is unable to learn to read and write.
 
• Most of the other Mughal Emperors were well educated. Akbar reigned from 1556 to 1605.

questions.question: What is the literal meaning of 'Certiorari'?

options.text: To be certified (or) to be informed

questions.solution: Certiorari is a Latin word which means “to be informed of, or to be made certain in regard to”

questions.question: Strait of Malacca separates which two land masses?

options.text: Malay Peninsula and Indonesian Island of Sumatra

questions.solution:
• Strait of Malacca is a narrow stretch of water which separates the Malay Peninsula and Indonesian Island of Sumatra.
 
• It was named after the Malacca Sultanate which ruled between 1400 and 1511 over a group of islands.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a plant hormone?
questions.solution:
• Thyroxin is** not **a plant hormone.
 
• It is a hormone produced in the human body secreted by the thyroid gland into the bloodstream.
 
• It is also known as T4 and is considered to be the most important thyroid hormones.

questions.question: Who appoints Governor of a state in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the **President of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The office of the Governor is the highest office in the state.
 
• The Governor is also called the first person of the state.
 
• The Governor is appointed and removed by the **President of India**.
 
• Governor holds the office till the President of India.
 
• Condition for the office of the governor:
 
 
• He should be an Indian Citizen.
 
• He should be 35 years old or more.
 
• He should not hold any office of profit.
 
• He cannot be a member of parliament or state legislature.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Which among the following is not an account under Balance of Payment?
questions.solution:
• The Balance of Payment also called a balance of International payments, is a record that consists of all the economic transactions of a country between its residents and of the world for over a year.
 
• The official reserves account does not come under it since it is a subdivision of the capital account.

questions.question: Anions are formed by _______.
questions.solution:
• Anions are negatively charged ions which are formed when a non metal gains electrons.
 
• While cations are positively charged ions which are formed when a metal loses electrons.

questions.question: Speed of light is maximum in _______.
questions.solution:
• The speed of light is maximum in a vacuum.
 
• The speed of light in a vacuum is 186,282 miles per second, which is 299,792 km per second.
 
• As per the theory, nothing travels faster than light.

questions.question: Which among the following is the major cause of acid rain?
questions.solution:
• Acid rain is caused because of a chemical reaction that occurs when compounds like nitrogen oxide and sulphur dioxide are released into the air.
 
• These substances rise up high in the atmosphere and get mixed with oxygen, water and other chemicals and react with them to form acidic pollutants and cause acid rain.

questions.question:
Match the following.

 
 

 
 
**Term**

 
 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 

 
 
 1. Globalisation

 
 
 
 a. Process of reducing or removing restrictions on international trade.

 
 
 

 
 
 2. Privatisation

 
 
 
 b. Process of interaction and integration among the people, companies and government of different nations.

 
 
 

 
 
 3. Liberalisation

 
 
 
 c. transfer of a business, industry, or service from public to private ownership and control
questions.solution:
• Globalization is the process of integration and interaction amongst people, government and companies of different nations.
 
• Privatization means the transfer of a business, industry, or service from the public to private ownership and control.
 
• Liberalization is the process of removing or reducing restrictions on International trade.

questions.question: An IP address is _____ bit number.
questions.solution:
• An IP address is a 32-bit number which identifies each receiver or sender of the information which is sent across the Internet in packets.
 
• It is assigned to each device which is connected to a computer network which makes use of Internet protocol for communication.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.solution:
• Ampere is the SI unit of electric current.
 
• Electric current is always measured with a device called ammeter.
 
• The electric charges that flow across a surface at a rate of 1 coulomb per second equal 1 ampere.
 
• It is denoted by a formula, Q=It, where Q is the charge, I is steady current flowing at time t.

questions.question: Process of losing electrons is known as _______.
questions.solution:
• Oxidation is the process when any ion, molecule or atom loses electrons during a chemical reaction.
 
• It occurs when there is an increase in the oxidation state of an atom, molecule or ion.
 
• The opposite process of oxidation is known as reduction which occurs when there is gain of electrons by an atom, molecule or ion, or when there is a decrease in the oxidation state.
